messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: Maya Patel (on-call) — GPU OOM storm detected on prefills for redwood-v1-large. 12 OOMs in 2m across node gpu-a12. Priority: P1 :rotating_light:
Maya Patel: I’m on it, acknowledging pager. Samir/Lee can you triage logs and suggest a quick mitigation?
Samir Khan: Looking now. Trace shows repeated CUDA OOM during prefill for very long prompts (~85k-130k tokens). Same stack: gpu-a12, container redwood-runtime-7.
Samir Khan: snippet of log: ```2026-03-17T14:02:11Z ERROR prefill: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (requested 4.2GiB)
stack: at runtime::alloc_kv_cache()
model=redwood-v1-large prompt_len=117824 current_alloc=34.7GiB host_free=2.1GiB```
Lee Chen: This smells like both long prefill allocation + fragmented GPU memory. Immediate mitigations: 1) cap prefill length to 32k tokens at the gateway, 2) route >32k to medium model, 3) enable aggressive kvcache eviction on the affected pool.
Maya Patel: Samir, can you run a quick memprofile and confirm fragmentation vs steady spike? I’ll stage rules to shed long prefill requests while we triage.
Samir Khan: Memprofile: prefill allocations ramp quickly then fail; fragmentation present — host_free low but total free fragmented. cudaMemGetInfo shows free ~1.9GiB before fail. Seems long linear prefill allocations pushing past peak.
Maya Patel: opsbot — please apply a temporary route and throttle rule: drop or redirect requests with context_length > 32000 to redwood-v1-medium and set prefill_concurrency=1 for the large model pool.
opsbot: Dynamic routing change applied to gateway cluster rtr-3: policy 'prefill-shed-32k' enabled. prefill_concurrency=1 applied to pool redwood-v1-large.
Customer Success: FYI — Acme reported increased errors on long-document summaries, ~4% of requests failing in the last 10m. We’ve opened a support ticket, customer notified that team is investigating.
Lee Chen: Also recommend toggling coldmodel fallback: if prefill fails with OOM then fallback to coldmodel (lower perf) instead of retrying on same node. Sample config: ```fallback: on_prefill_oom: action: coldmodel_route```
Samir Khan: I’m rolling a targeted restart for pods on gpu-a12 to clear fragmentation and force allocator reset. Will cordon node if restarts don't reduce rate.
Maya Patel: Restart initiated for redwood-runtime-7 on gpu-a12. Monitoring metrics now. Keeping oncall until we see error rate drop below 1% for 10m.
Samir Khan: After restart + routing change, OOM rate dropped to 3.1% over last 5m, prefill latency increased for redirected requests but they complete.
Lee Chen: Recommend we keep routing rule for 2 hours and run a controlled canary of kvcache-aggressive=true for 10% of traffic to validate memory behavior.
Maya Patel: Agreed. I’ve opened INC-2026-5920 and linked this thread. CS informed with ETA: mitigations in place, monitoring for stability.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-5920 created and assigned to Maya Patel. Pager acknowledged.
Maya Patel: Will update status page if we hit customer-impact thresholds or when stable. Staying oncall until 15:30Z or until stable.
Customer Success: Thanks — we’ve told Acme engineers you’re investigating and will follow up in 30m.
Samir Khan: Will follow up with a short postmortem draft after we stabilize; initial hypothesis: long-context prefill allocations + GPU fragmentation causing cudaMalloc OOMs.
Maya Patel: Closing loop for now — continuing monitoring. If anything changes ping @Maya.
